title: tabnas clib release artifact manifest
description: Per-release record of which prebuilt clib artifacts exist, written by the shared clib-release workflow (ADR-12 clause 5). Bindings' loaders parse this file, so it is a contract: absence must be explicit data (present:false), never inferred from a failed download, and a loader must verify sha256 before trusting a downloaded artifact — falling through to build-from-source on mismatch.

schema.description: Manifest schema version; this document describes version 1.

tag.description: The release tag these artifacts belong to.

targets.description: One entry per known target, ALWAYS including absent ones.

file.description: Artifact filename attached to the release.

sha256.description: Required when present:true; the loader must verify it.
